scope: The standing Senayan main stadium in Jakarta, with its continuous steel ring roof, two spectator tiers, surrounding concrete colonnade, running track and football field.

originalReview.notes: Aerial photograph establishes the continuous pale oval roof, recessed eave, dark inner roof structure and open two-level concrete frame.

quallaSearch.notes: Used the exact Qualla photograph of the named main stadium, deposited as the photographer’s own work with a public-domain release. Written government and owner records inform the post-2018 appearance.
